nodes.name: VK Webhook
nodes.notes: responseMode MUST be responseNode. The default returns JSON, and VK rejects the address unless the confirmation reply is the bare string.

nodes.name: Respond Confirmation
nodes.notes: Bare plain text, nothing else. Needs N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false for $env to resolve.

nodes.name: Respond OK
nodes.notes: Answer FIRST, think after. VK retries a slow endpoint and a retry means the same event processed twice. Execution continues past this node.

nodes.name: Secret Valid?
nodes.notes: The webhook URL is public. The shared secret is the only thing that makes a request trustworthy.

nodes.name: Drop — Bad Secret
nodes.notes: VK already got its 'ok'. An attacker learns nothing from the response.

nodes.name: Normalize VK Event
nodes.notes: Generated from builds/vk-adapter/normalize-vk.js by sync-code-node.py. Do not edit here.

nodes.name: Send Reply
nodes.notes: Query Auth credential supplies access_token, so the token never enters this file.

nodes.name: VK Returned An Error?
nodes.notes: VK answers 200 OK with an {"error": {...}} body on failure, so HTTP status alone never catches it.

nodes.name: Raise VK Error
nodes.notes: Surfaces as a failed execution so the Error Trigger workflow can alert.
